programmes.programName: Doctoral Program in Management Science and Technology
programmes.evidence: The official Management Science and Technology department overview explicitly names its Doctoral Program in Management Science and Technology. Its current programme page reports approximately 55 enrolled doctoral students. The same department's official Current PhD Holders page lists PhD graduates, including a 2026 holder, and its current PhD Candidates page identifies active candidates. Thus this is a research PhD programme hosted by a qualifying named department, not merely an Erasmus form degree-level choice. Individual graduates' thesis-field labels are not separate formal programme routes.
limitations: The exact diploma wording for an individual award is not established; the department explicitly calls graduates PhD holders.

branches.conclusion: Official eight-department inventory places Management Science and Technology in the School of Business; its doctoral programme and departmental PhD holder/candidate pages establish an active research PhD pathway. No individual thesis area is duplicated as a programme.

Official current university inventory lists three schools and eight departments, with no engineering school or Industrial Engineering department. Named doctoral specializations inside other non-qualifying host departments were not exhaustively screened; coverage remains false.
